LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在佳琳家慶祝寶寶滿月 · Celebrating baby's full month at Jialin's house

text.traditional: 芳草，恭喜佳琳生了這麼一對可愛的雙胞胎！今天滿月，家裡好熱鬧啊！
text.simplified: 芳草，恭喜佳琳生了这么一对可爱的双胞胎！今天满月，家里好热闹啊！
text.english: Mary: Fangcao, congratulations to Jialin for giving birth to such cute twins! Today is their full month; the house is so lively!

text.traditional: 是啊！你看，好精緻的油飯和紅蛋啊！聞起來真香。
text.simplified: 是啊！你看，好精緻的油饭和红蛋啊！闻起来真香。
text.english: Yes! Look, what exquisite oily glutinous rice and red eggs! They smell so fragrant.

text.traditional: 我今天特地親自挑選了兩套純棉的嬰兒服送給寶寶，希望他們健康長大。
text.simplified: 我今天特地亲自挑选了两套纯棉的婴儿服送给宝宝，希望他们健康长大。
text.english: I specially selected two sets of pure cotton baby clothes in person to give to the babies, hoping they grow up healthy.

text.traditional: 妳真有心。在臺灣，送禮送紅包很有講究，金額通常要雙數才吉利。
text.simplified: 你真有心。在台湾，送礼送红包很有讲究，金額通常要双数才吉利。
text.english: You are truly thoughtful. In Taiwan, giving gifts and red envelopes is very nuanced; amounts are usually even numbers for good fortune.

text.traditional: 剛才吃水果的時候，我想把梨子切開分給佳琳的婆婆，婆婆笑著跟我說不能分梨呢！
text.simplified: 刚才吃水果的时候，我想把梨子切开分给佳琳的婆婆，婆婆笑着跟我说不能分梨呢！
text.english: Just now when eating fruits, I wanted to slice the pear and share with Jialin's mother-in-law, and she smiled and told me we shouldn't share pears!

text.traditional: 哈哈，因為「分梨」聽起來像「分離」，長輩通常會避開這個諧音。
text.simplified: 哈哈，因为「分梨」听起来像「分离」，长辈通常会避开这个諧音。
text.english: Haha, because 'sharing pears' sounds like 'parting ways'; elders usually avoid this homophone.

text.traditional: 原來是這樣！我在禮品店找來找去，終於挑到滿意的禮物，今天學到了不少臺灣傳統習俗呢。
text.simplified: 原来是这样！我在礼品店找来找去，终于挑到满意的礼物，今天学到了不少台湾传统习俗呢。
text.english: So that's why! I searched back and forth in gift shops and finally picked a satisfying gift; I learned quite a few Taiwanese traditions today.

text.traditional: 吃完飯後桌上的美味菜餚如果吃不完，我們還可以打包帶回家，不要浪費食物喔！
text.simplified: 吃完饭后桌上的美味菜餚如果吃不完，我们还可以打包带回家，不要浪费食物喔！
text.english: After eating, if the delicious dishes on the table aren't finished, we can also box them up to take home; don't waste food!

LESSON_FOUR_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 佳琳的信：坐月子與滿月 · Jialin's Letter: Confinement and Full Month

text.traditional: 親愛的以晴，收到妳寄來的婚禮照片，看到妳美麗幸福的模樣，真替妳高興！
text.simplified: 亲爱的以晴，收到你寄来的婚礼照片，看到你美丽幸福的模样，真替你高兴！
text.english: Dear Yiqing, receiving the wedding photos you sent and seeing your beautiful, happy appearance, I am so joyful for you!

text.traditional: 可惜因為我剛生完雙胞胎，正在坐月子，沒辦法親自飛到美國參加妳的婚禮。
text.simplified: 可惜因为我刚生完双胞胎，正在坐月子，没办法亲自飞到美国参加你的婚礼。
text.english: Unfortunately, because I just gave birth to twins and am doing postpartum confinement, I couldn't fly to America in person to attend your wedding.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，女人生產後都要坐月子一個月，每天吃麻油雞調養身體，也不能吹風。
text.simplified: 在台湾，女人生产后都要坐月子一个月，每天吃麻油鸡调养身体，也不能吹风。
text.english: In Taiwan, after giving birth women rest in confinement for a month, eating sesame oil chicken daily to nurse the body, and cannot catch drafts.

text.traditional: 這一個月裡，兩個寶寶整天哭個不停，吵著要喝奶，忙得我和先生連睡覺的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 这一个月里，两个宝宝整天哭个不停，吵着要喝奶，忙得我和先生连睡觉的时间都没有。
text.english: During this month, the two babies cried incessantly all day, clamoring for milk, keeping my husband and me so busy that we didn't even have sleep time.

text.traditional: 今天孩子終於滿月了，家裡除了前來祝賀的親戚朋友以外，就是送給客人的油飯和蛋糕。
text.simplified: 今天孩子终于满月了，家里除了前来祝贺的亲戚朋友以外，就是送给客人的油饭和蛋糕。
text.english: Today the children finally completed their full month; in the house, besides visiting relatives and friends, there is only oily rice and cake for guests.

text.traditional: 雖然照顧雙胞胎的生活不是餵奶就是換尿布，但看著寶寶一天天長大，心裡感到無比的幸福。
text.simplified: 虽然照顾双胞胎的生活不是喂奶就是换尿布，但看着宝宝一天天长大，心里感到无比的幸福。
text.english: Although caring for twins means either feeding or diaper-changing, watching the babies grow day by day brings boundless happiness to the heart.

LESSON_FOUR_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–4 · The Baby's Full Month

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclaim admiration or shock at a vivid quality using 好+Vs+的+N啊.
grammarPages.explanation: This exclamatory phrase expresses emotional exclamation regarding an outstanding or extreme attribute of a noun.
grammarPages.pattern: 好 + Adjective + 的 + Noun + 啊！

patternRows.english: What exquisite glutinous oil rice!
What sour lemon juice!
What a cute baby!

items.question: Can 好+Vs+的+N啊 be used as a plain question?
items.answer: No. It is purely an exclamatory praise pattern, not an inquiry.

items.question: Can 的 be omitted before the noun?
items.answer: 的 is required to link the modified stative verb phrase to the head noun.

text.traditional: 你看，好精緻的油飯和紅蛋啊！
text.simplified: 你看，好精緻的油饭和红蛋啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, hǎo jīngzhì de yóufàn hé hóngdàn a!
text.english: Look, what exquisite oily rice and red eggs!

text.traditional: 好酸的檸檬汁啊！你忘了加糖嗎？
text.simplified: 好酸的柠檬汁啊！你忘了加糖吗？
text.pinyin: Hǎo suān de níngméngzhī a! Nǐ wàng le jiā táng ma?
text.english: What sour lemon juice! Did you forget to add sugar?

text.traditional: 今天晚上好美麗的夜景啊！從這裡看臺北真漂亮。
text.simplified: 今天晚上好美丽的夜景啊！从这里看台北真漂亮。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng hǎo měilì de yèjǐng a! Cóng zhèlǐ kàn Táiběi zhēn piàoliang.
text.english: What a beautiful night view tonight! Looking at Taipei from here is truly gorgeous.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 好+Vs+的+N啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize doing an action oneself rather than delegating it using 親自.
grammarPages.explanation: 親自 emphasizes that a subject performs an action directly in person, highlighting respect, sincerity, or importance.

subject.meaning: used in 瑪瑙|玛瑙[ma3 nao3]

columns.meaning: used in 瑪瑙|玛瑙[ma3 nao3]

patternRows.english: Mary personally selects baby clothes.
My son personally brought it to my company for me.

subject.meaning: chairman of the board of directors

columns.meaning: chairman of the board of directors

patternRows.english: The chairman personally attended the awards ceremony.

items.question: How does 親自 differ from 自己?
items.answer: 親自 emphasizes in-person physical presence and sincerity; 自己 means by oneself without help.

right.pinyin: Tā zìjǐ chī le yì wǎn fàn.
right.english: He ate a bowl of rice by himself.

items.question: Where does 親自 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 親自 is an adverb and must precede the verb phrase it modifies.

right.english: He came to pick me up in person.

text.traditional: 我早上出門時忘了帶手機，沒想到兒子親自拿到公司給我。
text.simplified: 我早上出门时忘了带手机，没想到儿子亲自拿到公司给我。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshàng chūmén shí wàng le dài shǒujī, méi xiǎngdào érzi qīnzì ná dào gōngsī gěi wǒ.
text.english: I forgot my phone when leaving this morning; unexpectedly my son brought it to the company for me in person.

text.traditional: 為了表示誠意，經理決定親自拜訪重要的合作廠商。
text.simplified: 为了表示诚意，经理决定亲自拜访重要的合作厂商。
text.pinyin: Wèile biǎoshì chéngyì, jīnglǐ juédìng qīnzì bàifǎng zhòngyào de hézuò chǎngshāng.
text.english: To demonstrate sincerity, the manager decided to visit the important partnering manufacturer in person.

text.traditional: 這件木雕藝術品是那位老師傅親手親自雕刻完成的。
text.simplified: 这件木雕艺术品是那位老师傅亲手亲自雕刻完成的。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn mùdiāo yìshùpǐn shì nà wèi lǎoshīfù qīnshǒu qīnzì diāokè wánchéng de.
text.english: This woodcarving art piece was carved and completed personally by that master craftsman.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express repetitive or back-and-forth action using V來V去.
grammarPages.explanation: This structure describes an action performed repeatedly in various directions or manners, often without conclusive resolution.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 來 + Verb + 去

complement.meaning: to carry on a shoulder pole

columns.meaning: to carry on a shoulder pole

patternRows.english: I picked and chose in the shop over and over, but still couldn't find a suitable one.
Looking for jobs over and over, I still couldn't find an ideal one.

subject.meaning: house (M: 棟 dòng, 個 gè)

columns.meaning: house (M: 棟 dòng, 個 gè)

patternRows.english: Looking at houses all around, I feel this neighborhood is the best.

items.question: Can multi-syllable verbs fit V來V去?
items.answer: No. The verb in V來V去 must be monosyllabic (走來走去, 想來想去, 看了又看).

items.question: Can V來V去 describe a completed single trip?
items.answer: No. V來V去 implies aimless or repeated back-and-forth action without resolution.

right.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān lǐ zǒu lái zǒu qù.
right.english: He paced back and forth in the room.

text.traditional: 我在禮品店找來找去，最後終於挑到滿意的禮物。
text.simplified: 我在礼品店找来找去，最后终于挑到满意的礼物。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài lǐpǐndiàn zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zuìhòu zhōngyú tiāo dào mǎnyì de lǐwù.
text.english: I searched back and forth in the gift store, and finally picked out a satisfying gift.

words.meaning: to carry on a shoulder pole

text.traditional: 這幾個月我不斷地找工作，找來找去，還是找不到滿意的薪水。
text.simplified: 这几个月我不断地找工作，找来找去，还是找不到满意的薪水。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ ge yuè wǒ búduàn de zhǎo gōngzuò, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, háishì zhǎo bù dào mǎnyì de xīnshuǐ.
text.english: I searched continuously for jobs these months; searching back and forth, I still can't find a satisfying salary.

text.traditional: 我看來看去，還是覺得這個社區的生活機能最方便。
text.simplified: 我看来看去，还是觉得这个社区的生活机能最方便。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juéde zhège shèqū de shēnghuó jīnéng zuì fāngbiàn.
text.english: Looking over and over, I still feel this neighborhood's amenities are the most convenient.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using V來V去 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 他在客廳裡焦急地___，不知道在等誰的電話。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express the eventual attainment of a goal after long effort using 終於.
grammarPages.explanation: 終於 expresses that an anticipated result or outcome is achieved after a long wait, effort, or difficulty.

patternRows.english: The baby has finally reached one month of age.
Mom searched for a long time and finally found her passport in her pocket.
Through hard work, we finally finished this movie.

items.question: How does 終於 differ from 最後?
items.answer: 終於 conveys emotional relief after a long wait or hardship; 最後 is simply sequential.
items.wrongTraditional: 他終於說了一句話然後走了。
items.wrongSimplified: 他终于说了一句话然后走了。

right.traditional: 他最後說了一句話然後走了。
right.simplified: 他最后说了一句话然后走了。
right.pinyin: Tā zuìhòu shuō le yí jù huà ránhòu zǒu le.
right.english: Finally he said one sentence, and then left.

items.question: Can 終於 be used for an easily accomplished task?
items.answer: No. 終於 requires prior effort, waiting, or obstacles overcome.

right.english: I finally passed the college entrance exam.

text.traditional: 今天孩子終於滿月了，親戚朋友們都來祝福。
text.simplified: 今天孩子终于满月了，亲戚朋友们都来祝福。
text.pinyin: Jīntiān háizi zhōngyú mǎnyuè le, qīnqī péngyǒu men dōu lái zhùfú.
text.english: Today the babies finally reached their full month; relatives and friends all came to bestow blessings.

words.meaning: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals

text.traditional: 媽媽到了機場才發現護照不見了，找來找去，終於在她的口袋裡找到了。
text.simplified: 妈妈到了机场才发现护照不见了，找来找去，终于在她的口袋里找到了。
text.pinyin: Māma dào le jīchǎng cái fāxiàn hùzhào bújiàn le, zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zhōngyú zài tā de kǒudài lǐ zhǎodào le.
text.english: Mother realized her passport was missing upon reaching the airport; searching back and forth, she finally found it in her pocket.

text.traditional: 經過三年的研發與測試，這款新產品終於正式上市了。
text.simplified: 经过三年的研发与测试，这款新产品终于正式上市了。
text.pinyin: Jīngguò sān nián de yánfā yǔ cèshì, zhè kuǎn xīn chǎnpǐn zhōngyú zhèngshì shàngshì le.
text.english: Through three years of R&D and testing, this new product finally launched officially on the market.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe continuous, unstoppable actions using V個不停.
grammarPages.explanation: V個不停 or V個沒完 indicates that an action continues relentlessly without pause, often with a feeling of tiredness or exasperation.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 個不停 / 個沒完

patternRows.english: The baby cries non-stop all day, demanding to drink milk.
Meetings go on non-stop without end; it's exhausting.
The phone rings endlessly; I can't even answer them all.

items.question: Can multi-syllable verbs take 個不停?
items.answer: Typically monosyllabic verbs of expressive action take 個不停 (哭個不停, 笑個不停, 說個不停).

items.question: Can 個 be omitted in V個不停?
items.answer: 個 serves as an informal aspectual infix emphasizing quantity or duration; keep it in this colloquial pattern.

text.traditional: 最近工作很多，我們每天開會開個不停，電話也接個不停，累死了。
text.simplified: 最近工作很多，我们每天开会开个不停，电话也接个不停，累死了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn duō, wǒmen měitiān kāihuì kāi ge bùtíng, diànhuà yě jiē ge bùtíng, lèi sǐ le.
text.english: Recently there is so much work; we hold meetings non-stop daily and answer phones incessantly, exhausted to death.

words.meaning: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals

text.traditional: 外面的大雨下個不停，很多低窪地區都積水了。
text.simplified: 外面的大雨下个不停，很多低窪地区都积水了。
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn de dàyǔ xià ge bùtíng, hěn duō dīwā dìqū dōu jīshuǐ le.
text.english: The heavy rain outside poured non-stop, and many low-lying areas accumulated water.

text.traditional: 這兩個孩子一見面就吵個沒完，媽媽覺得頭痛極了。
text.simplified: 这两个孩子一见面就吵个没完，妈妈觉得头痛极了。
text.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge háizi yí jiànmiàn jiù chǎo ge méiwán, māma juéde tóutòng jí le.
text.english: These two kids quarrel endlessly as soon as they meet; mother has an immense headache.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe a moderate state that avoids extremes using 不A不B.
grammarPages.explanation: This four-character frame pairs contrasting or related antonym adjectives to indicate a moderate, balanced, or neutral state.
grammarPages.pattern: 不 + Adj A + 不 + Adj B

patternRows.english: Autumn weather is neither cold nor hot, very comfortable.
The teacher speaks neither too fast nor too slow, explaining very clearly.
This shirt size is neither too large nor too small, fitting just right.

items.question: Can 不A不B take random antonyms?
items.answer: It uses established coordinate antonym pairs (不冷不熱, 不大不小, 不長不短) to express ideal moderation.

right.traditional: 這件衣服不大不小正好。
right.simplified: 这件衣服不大不小正好。
right.pinyin: Zhè jiàn yīfu bú dà bù xiǎo zhènghǎo.
right.english: These clothes are neither big nor small; just right.

items.question: Does 不A不B convey extreme negativity?
items.answer: No. It usually conveys pleasant moderation or comfortable middle ground.
items.wrongTraditional: 今天天氣不冷不熱真糟糕。
items.wrongSimplified: 今天天气不冷不热真糟糕。

right.traditional: 今天天氣不冷不熱很舒服。
right.simplified: 今天天气不冷不热很舒服。
right.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì bù lěng bú rè hěn shūfu.
right.english: Today's weather is neither cold nor hot; very comfortable.

text.traditional: 這種不冷不熱的天氣舒服極了，不但適合野餐、露營，還很適合登山。
text.simplified: 这种不冷不热的天气舒服极了，不但适合野餐、露营，还很适合登山。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng bù lěng bú rè de tiānqì shūfu jí le, búdàn shìhé yěcān, lùyíng, hái hěn shìhé dēngshān.
text.english: This weather that is neither cold nor hot is extremely comfortable; it is not only suitable for picnics and camping, but also great for hiking.

text.traditional: 林老師說話的速度不快不慢，例子的說明也很清楚，學生很容易就明白了。
text.simplified: 林老师说话的速度不快不慢，例子的说明也很清楚，学生很容易就明白了。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎoshī shuōhuà de sùdù bú kuài bú màn, lìzi de shuōmíng yě hěn qīngchu, xuésheng hěn róngyì jiù míngbai le.
text.english: Teacher Lin speaks neither fast nor slow, and explanations with examples are very clear; students understand easily.

text.traditional: 挑選鞋子時，一定要選不大不小、穿著合腳的鞋子。
text.simplified: 挑选鞋子时，一定要选不大不小、穿着合脚的鞋子。
text.pinyin: Tiāoxuǎn xiézi shí, yídìng yào xuǎn bú dà bù xiǎo, chuān zhe héjiǎo de xiézi.
text.english: When choosing shoes, one must select a pair neither big nor small that fits the feet snugly.

words.meaning: to carry on a shoulder pole

questions.prompt: 這裡的咖啡甜度___，微苦中帶著甘甜，我很喜歡。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize an exclusive situation where only one or two things exist using 除了…就是….
grammarPages.explanation: 除了 A 就是 B expresses that apart from A, there is only B; indicating an exclusive, monotonous, or narrow situation.
grammarPages.pattern: 除了 + Category A + 就是 + Category B

patternRows.english: At home, aside from guests, there is only sticky rice and cake everywhere.
At work, besides brewing coffee, all I do is wipe tables and take out the trash.
In the fridge, besides beer, there's nothing but popsicles and eggs.

items.question: How does 除了…就是… differ from 除了…還有…?
items.answer: 除了…就是… expresses exclusive limitation (nothing else except this); 除了…還有… is open addition.
items.wrongTraditional: 桌上除了書就是筆還有水。
items.wrongSimplified: 桌上除了书就是笔还有水。

right.pinyin: Zhuō shàng chúle shū jiùshì bǐ.
right.english: On the desk there is nothing except books and pens.

items.question: Can 就是 be replaced by 也是 in this pattern?
items.answer: No. 就是 signals the exclusive focus ('only X and nothing else'); 也是 breaks the pattern.
items.wrongTraditional: 他每天除了工作也是工作。
items.wrongSimplified: 他每天除了工作也是工作。

right.traditional: 他每天除了工作就是工作。
right.simplified: 他每天除了工作就是工作。
right.pinyin: Tā měitiān chúle gōngzuò jiùshì gōngzuò.
right.english: Every day, apart from work, he does nothing but work.

text.traditional: 小李在咖啡館打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他覺得有點乏味。
text.simplified: 小李在咖啡馆打工，每天除了煮咖啡以外，就是擦桌子、倒垃圾，他觉得有点乏味。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ zài kāfēiguǎn dǎgōng, měitiān chúle zhǔ kāfēi yǐwài, jiùshì cā zhuōzi, dào lājī, tā juéde yǒudiǎn fáwèi.
text.english: Xiao Li works part-time at the cafe; every day besides brewing coffee, it's just wiping tables and taking out trash; he feels it's somewhat tedious.

text.traditional: 我家冰箱裡的東西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水果和雞蛋。
text.simplified: 我家冰箱里的东西不多，除了啤酒，就是一些水果和鸡蛋。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā bīngxiāng lǐ de dōngxi bù duō, chúle píjiǔ, jiùshì yìxiē shuǐguǒ hé jīdàn.
text.english: There isn't much in my refrigerator; other than beer, it's just some fruit and eggs.

words.meaning: classifier indicating a small amount or small number greater than 1: some, a few, several

text.traditional: 他生活圈很單純，每天除了公司，就是回家睡覺。
text.simplified: 他生活圈很单纯，每天除了公司，就是回家睡觉。
text.pinyin: Tā shēnghuóquān hěn dānchún, měitiān chúle gōngsī, jiùshì huíjiā shuìjiào.
text.english: His social circle is very simple; every day besides the office, it's just returning home to sleep.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: If Not A, Then B (Either Or)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: State an either-or dichotomy using 不是…就是….
grammarPages.explanation: 不是 A 就是 B indicates that an outcome or situation invariably falls into one of two options.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不是 + Option A + 就是 + Option B

patternRows.english: Caring for a baby is either feeding milk or changing diapers.
On vacation, Xiaohua is either working out or taking part in events.
Center activities are either singing or dancing.

items.question: Does 不是…就是… allow a third alternative?
items.answer: No. 不是 A 就是 B indicates an either/or dilemma where it is invariably one of the two.
items.wrongTraditional: 他不是看書就是睡覺或者是運動。
items.wrongSimplified: 他不是看书就是睡觉或者是运动。

right.pinyin: Tā bú shì kànshū jiùshì shuìjiào.
right.english: If he isn't reading, he is sleeping.

items.question: Can 不是…就是… mean both are true together?
items.answer: No. For both qualities, use 不但…而且… or 不僅…也….
items.wrongTraditional: 他又聰明又善良不是聰明就是善良。
items.wrongSimplified: 他又聪明又善良不是聪明就是善良。

right.pinyin: Tā bùjǐn cōngmíng yě hěn shànliáng.
right.english: He is not only smart but also kind.

text.traditional: 小華很會利用放假的時間，不是去健身，就是參加各種社團活動。
text.simplified: 小华很会利用放假的时间，不是去健身，就是参加各种社团活动。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Huá hěn huì lìyòng fàngjià de shíjiān, bú shì qù jiànshēn, jiùshì cānjiā gè zhǒng shètuán huódòng.
text.english: Xiao Hua utilizes vacation time well; if he's not working out, he's participating in various club activities.

text.traditional: 每年華語中心的春節活動，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，非常歡樂熱鬧。
text.simplified: 每年华语中心的春节活动，不是唱歌，就是跳舞，非常欢乐热闹。
text.pinyin: Měi nián huáyǔ zhōngxīn de chūnjié huódòng, bú shì chànggē, jiùshì tiàowǔ, fēicháng huānlè rènào.
text.english: Every year the Chinese Center's Lunar New Year activities are either singing or dancing, extremely cheerful and lively.

text.traditional: 週末爸爸在家，不是在陽台澆花，就是在書房看書。
text.simplified: 周末爸爸在家，不是在阳台澆花，就是在书房看书。
text.pinyin: Zhōumò bàba zài jiā, bú shì zài yángtái jiāohuā, jiùshì zài shūfáng kànshū.
text.english: On weekends when dad is home, if he's not watering flowers on the balcony, he's reading books in the study.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 佳琳的信：坐月子與滿月 · Jialin's Letter: Confinement and Full Month

text.traditional: 親愛的以晴，收到妳寄來的婚禮照片，看到妳美麗幸福的模樣，真替妳高興！
text.simplified: 亲爱的以晴，收到你寄来的婚礼照片，看到你美丽幸福的模样，真替你高兴！
text.english: Dear Yiqing, receiving the wedding photos you sent and seeing your beautiful, happy appearance, I am so joyful for you!

text.traditional: 可惜因為我剛生完雙胞胎，正在坐月子，沒辦法親自飛到美國參加妳的婚禮。
text.simplified: 可惜因为我刚生完双胞胎，正在坐月子，没办法亲自飞到美国参加你的婚礼。
text.english: Unfortunately, because I just gave birth to twins and am doing postpartum confinement, I couldn't fly to America in person to attend your wedding.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，女人生產後都要坐月子一個月，每天吃麻油雞調養身體，也不能吹風。
text.simplified: 在台湾，女人生产后都要坐月子一个月，每天吃麻油鸡调养身体，也不能吹风。
text.english: In Taiwan, after giving birth women rest in confinement for a month, eating sesame oil chicken daily to nurse the body, and cannot catch drafts.

text.traditional: 這一個月裡，兩個寶寶整天哭個不停，吵著要喝奶，忙得我和先生連睡覺的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 这一个月里，两个宝宝整天哭个不停，吵着要喝奶，忙得我和先生连睡觉的时间都没有。
text.english: During this month, the two babies cried incessantly all day, clamoring for milk, keeping my husband and me so busy that we didn't even have sleep time.

text.traditional: 今天孩子終於滿月了，家裡除了前來祝賀的親戚朋友以外，就是送給客人的油飯和蛋糕。
text.simplified: 今天孩子终于满月了，家里除了前来祝贺的亲戚朋友以外，就是送给客人的油饭和蛋糕。
text.english: Today the children finally completed their full month; in the house, besides visiting relatives and friends, there is only oily rice and cake for guests.

text.traditional: 雖然照顧雙胞胎的生活不是餵奶就是換尿布，但看著寶寶一天天長大，心裡感到無比的幸福。
text.simplified: 虽然照顾双胞胎的生活不是喂奶就是换尿布，但看着宝宝一天天长大，心里感到无比的幸福。
text.english: Although caring for twins means either feeding or diaper-changing, watching the babies grow day by day brings boundless happiness to the heart.
